inspiration: Ranked attack options in one clip: sorted by annotation priority, first option that passes all checks wins, the rest are skipped (src/Hook_AttackCombo.cpp:22; src/SCARActionData.cpp:297-300).
Chance is rolled per option, then the range test runs, so a rare heavy move and a frequent light move share one clip (src/SCARActionData.cpp:212; docs/EN/Developers Manual For SCAR 2.0+.md:24).
Reach as a sector in the attacker's own frame: distance band, facing window and height overlap, with the target's bound radius added (src/Function.cpp:56-110).
Two cooldown models: a shared alias several options respect, or an option's own timer; idle options without an alias get no cooldown (src/SCARActionData.cpp:112, 231, 254).
Reach-arc telegraph: outer sector for reach, inner ring for the dead zone, a line to the target; currently a debug overlay only (src/Function.cpp:113-143).
Windup-window gating: a heavy option is valid only between two local times of its own clip (src/SCARActionData.cpp:191).
Engine-style pause after a finished attack for pathing attackers, reproduced as a game-setting-driven delay (src/Hook_AttackStart.cpp:13-16).
Known oddities to avoid: the priority field is an annotation time (docs line 31), and the chance clamp range is -180..180 for a 0-100 field (src/SCARActionData.cpp:32).

briefs.label: Reach-arc telegraph
briefs.why: Danger reads as a ground sector before the hit, so the player can step out of it.
briefs.keep: outer sector for reach; inner ring for the dead zone; a line to the target
briefs.change: our palette; ground fill that pulses during windup; a fade, not a debug overlay

briefs.label: Chance-stacked action ladder
briefs.why: One creature mixes a rare heavy move and a common light move with no extra states.
briefs.keep: ordered options, each with a chance and a range band; first pass wins
briefs.change: options are zone/creature data rows, not strings in animation files; each option has a telegraph tag

briefs.label: Windup-gated heavy strike
briefs.why: A heavy move fires only in a short slice of its windup, so a timed dodge matters.
briefs.keep: a clip-time window that gates the move
briefs.change: window measured in our rig's frames; a sound cue when it opens; a different impact sign
